title: Final Frequency
description: Essential Criteria: The new frequency of the X-ray must be correctly calculated as 2.42 x 10^19 Hz.

title: Wavelength Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The calculation of the initial wavelength from the frequency must be shown correctly.

title: Compton Wavelength
description: Important Criteria: The use of the electron's Compton wavelength in the calculation must be clearly stated.

title: Scattering Angle
description: Important Criteria: The angle of scattering (90 degrees) must be correctly applied in the wavelength formula.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The units of frequency and wavelength must be consistent throughout the solution.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Common errors include incorrect signs in the wavelength calculation or misunderstanding the scattering angle.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Failing to include the Compton wavelength in the final wavelength equation is a common mistake.
